faqs.question: How are delivery charges and timelines calculated?
faqs.answer: Orders meeting our free-shipping threshold (currently ₹999 or above) qualify for complimentary standard shipping across India. Orders below the threshold incur a flat ₹99 delivery charge. Standard delivery takes 3–6 business days depending on your pin code.

faqs.question: How can I track my order securely?
faqs.answer: Visit the Track Order page and enter your unique Order Reference (e.g., MDK-YYYYMMDD-XXXX) along with the email address or phone number used during checkout. Registered customers can also view all orders under My Orders.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted at checkout?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking, and supported Wallets through our verified payment gateway integration. All payable amounts, taxes, and discounts are verified on our server before payment initialization.

faqs.question: Are my card or UPI details stored on the Samad Expo website?
faqs.answer: No. Samad Expo never collects or stores raw card numbers, CVVs, UPI PINs, or net banking passwords. All payment authorizations are processed directly by our PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway.

faqs.question: What is your return and refund policy?
faqs.answer: Eligible unused items in original packaging with intact tags and accessories may be requested for return within 7 days of delivery. Once inspected and approved, refunds are processed back to the original payment source with a verifiable transaction reference.

faqs.question: Are the current products on the storefront demonstration items?
faqs.answer: Yes. The initial items labeled 'Demo Item' are demonstration catalogue entries created to showcase full search, filtering, cart, checkout, and inventory capabilities. Authorized staff can replace or unpublish them anytime from the Admin Dashboard.

blogPosts.title: Samad Expo Establishes Official Central Digital Headquarters
blogPosts.excerpt: Unifying our independent websites, web applications, and business divisions under a central parent-company brand and digital directory.
blogPosts.content:
Today marks a pivotal milestone for our organization with the official launch of the Samad Expo corporate website and central digital headquarters.

As our operations have expanded across direct e-commerce, cloud platform engineering, and digital media, establishing a clear parent company identity became essential.

Samad Expo will continue to champion independent brand identities: every website in our ecosystem retains its specialized domain, unique branding, and tailored customer experience. Simultaneously, all properties benefit from shared cryptographic security, centralized governance, and high-performance server infrastructure.

We look forward to introducing upcoming business divisions and welcome strategic partners to collaborate with us.
blogPosts.author: Samad Expo Executive Office

blogPosts.title: Decentralized Branding with Centralized Governance: Our Architectural Philosophy
blogPosts.excerpt: Why forcing every product into a single generic layout fails, and how Samad Expo empowers distinct digital platforms to thrive.
blogPosts.content:
In modern digital business, one size never fits all. A specialized tech developer tool requires a vastly different interface and tone than a lifestyle retail storefront or an interactive educational academy.

At Samad Expo, we rejected the traditional monolithic website model in favor of an interconnected ecosystem:

1. Independent Branding: Every platform maintains its unique domain, visual identity, and audience focus.
2. Centralized Security: All platforms share verified payment protocols, cryptographic signatures, and audit standards.
3. Central Directory: Visitors can discover and navigate across all Samad Expo properties from our central headquarters.

This architecture ensures scalability for over 100+ future independent platforms without rebuilding core systems.
